newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Tuesday, dealers said, following the holiday weekend.
Friday, the benchmark July contract ended up 0.05 cent at 11.11 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.12 to 11.03 cents. The rest of the board settled 0.04 higher to down 0.01 cent.
Resistance was pegged at 11.20 cents for July, with support at 10.85 followed by 10.70 cents.
India said sugar output in 1996/97 could fall to 13 million tonnes from 16.5 million tonnes in the previous year.
LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly lower on Tuesday in thin, post-holiday trade. At 0843 EDT/1243 GMT, August stood $0.10 lower at $320.60.
